courses.summary: 阿祖爾工程由多個 EPC 套件組成；本課以分包接口與全廠產品、公用設施帳檢查整合完整性。本課依序分析分包到全廠收率、套件間熱量交接、氫氣使用者分配、不同承包商資料基準、整體可用率限制，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Al-Zour was delivered through multiple EPC packages; this case checks integration through package interfaces and plant-wide balances. The course analyses package-to-site yield account, thermal handover between packages, allocation among hydrogen users, data bases across contractors, site-wide availability constraints, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
